summary: Walter Taylor Bridge approach: through road with no parking and no room to stop.

drivers.seclusion: No homes mapped, but the road is exposed bridge approach with no cover.
drivers.access_and_room: Two-lane road with kerb and bridge barrier on the west edge; no pull-off. Only car park is off to the west, a separate place.
drivers.traffic: Busy bridge approach with a rail line beside it.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb in either image.

flags: DEM slope is unreliable on the bridge (max 28%)
Low-lying near the Brisbane River, min 5.3 m
sun_shade: Open; bridge tower shades the north end in the morning.
